integrity: Exact point counts use full enumeration of F4 and F16 and a standalone dependency-free checker; infinite isogeny-extension assertions are proved using the roots-of-unity orders and the Tate isogeny criterion.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns only the four F4 coefficient values, isogeny rather than isomorphism, and finite-field arithmetic. Previously known genus-two classification and the geometric Ekedahl--Oort calculation are expressly not claimed as new; unindexed coverage of the coupled calculation is possible. No independent review was performed.
title: Frobenius phases and minimal isogeny fields in a supersingular genus-six family
